cd /app/tmp && timeout 20 python3 -c "
import json,random,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
rng=random.Random(2024)
big_fib=[];seen=set();i=0
while len(big_fib) < 2048:
    L = [1,2,4,8,16,17,32,33,48,49,64,65,80,81,96,97,112,113,126,127,128][i % 21]
    net = (rng.getrandbits(L) << (128-L)) if L else 0
    if (net,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((net,L)); big_fib.append((net,L,rng.randrange(65536))); i+=1
json.dump({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l,'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in big_fib],'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32}, open('/app/tmp/bigfib.json','w'))
print('ok')
"; echo "rc=$?"
